title: Google Trends Scraper API output
description: Google Trends rows in the default dataset (switch between the Keywords, Interest over time, Interest by region, Trending Now and Topic suggestions views), plus a run summary record.

results.title: Results table (results)
results.description: Every row of the run in the default dataset: one per keyword, per Trending Now search or per suggestions lookup. Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: every keyword you typed with its status (ok, partial or skipped), the reason in plain English and the parts Google left empty.
